_comment: Fail-closed ratchet for two neighbouring tactic-diagnostic defect classes (RC-Q / brick T0 of docs/plans/TACTICS_TO_100_2026-07-29.md). `silent` = the probe declaration failed with NO diagnostic anywhere naming the construct, so the user sees only `declaration uses synthetic sorry`; that class is unactionable AND unmeasurable, and baseline_silent is 0 and MUST STAY 0 - do not raise it to land a tactic. `unnamed` = the ATTRIBUTION class: the declaration fails loudly, but nothing in the diagnostic says which tactic gave up, so a reader cannot tell whether `omega` ran and gave up or was never reached - the tactic is effectively hidden. It is ratcheted twice: on the aggregate count (baseline_unnamed) and, because a count alone cannot see a one-for-one swap, on the exact set of (token, label) rows allowed to be unattributed (known_unnamed_rows). Regenerate the census with CLEAN_SILENT_CENSUS_UPDATE=1 cargo test --offline --release -p clean-elab --test silent_tactic_census, then ratchet down with scripts/check_silent_tactic_ratchet.py --update.

measured_on_origin_main_2026_08_07.note: 27 of 374 probes over 288 tactic tokens produced zero diagnostics. Silent tokens were: cases (| _ =>), clear, conv (in / tactic =>), conv_lhs, conv_rhs, guard_target, let', letI, module, on_goal, rcases (- pattern), rename_i, revert, rw, set, set!, specialize, subst, conv-mode tactic, conv-mode tactic', unfold, and the ELIMINATOR notation. sorry/admit are intentional and excluded.

measured_on_origin_main_2026_08_09.note: 88 of 373 probes over 66 tactic tokens failed with a diagnostic that named no tactic. ~62 were the block-level `unsolved goals`, which is raised after every tactic already returned Ok and therefore never carried one; the rest were term-level diagnostics (TypeMismatch, UnknownIdentWithSuggestions, TooManyArguments, ProofTypeMismatch) escaping through a tactic's argument elaboration. Reproduced 1:1 under real `import Init`: of 195 declarations in one file, 63 pass / 45 named / 87 UNATTRIBUTED before, 63 pass / 125 named / 7 UNATTRIBUTED after - the pass set is byte-identical, so attribution changed no verdict.

residual_unattributed.note: The rows still allowed to be unattributed are NOT attribution defects and must not be 'fixed' by inventing a tactic name. Two honest causes: (1) argument-grammar leakage (RC-I) - `unfold a b`, `delta a`, `dsimp only [..]`, `intros h` parse the extra token as the NEXT tactic, so `UnknownTactic("b")` names the tactic that really failed; blaming `unfold` would be false. (2) desugaring drops the source spelling - `rwa [h]` runs as `(rw [h]; assumption)` and `next => t` parses as `case _ => t`, so the chain correctly names `assumption` / `case`. Closing (2) needs the parser to carry the written spelling through desugaring; closing (1) is brick T13.
